scope: One diagnostic print and one non-load-bearing MODE ring only.

before.state: Template/build notes exist; no physical ring geometry or detent has been validated in this receipt.
before.question: Does the printed strip become a freely rotating, legible four-position ring with a simple usable detent?

use: Print one template at 100% / Actual Size / no fit-to-page.
Measure the MODE strip before cutting against the declared dimensions.
Make only one MODE ring around a sacrificial ~50 mm core with a temporary reference line and light detent.
Cycle all four positions repeatedly and perform one ordinary pickup/handling check.
after: One MODE-ring specimen plus PASS/FAIL on scale, fit, rotation, centering/readability and detent hold.
evidence: Photo of printed strip with ruler.
Photo of assembled ring centered on one token under the reference.
next: PASS → build remaining rings and run Experiment A. FAIL → correct one defect class only, then repeat the one-ring diagnostic.
